content:
tara_marketing: Need a compact battlecard + webinar blurb that highlights our serving-first angle vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Deliverables: 1) SDR one-pager (3 hooks + 3 rebuttals), 2) 1-slide bench blurb, 3) routing rules for webinar leads. Deadline: Tue EOD. Who can own?

liam_research: I'll provide sanitized bench highlights (internal only). Paste:```text
Workload: multi-turn assist, avg 340 tokens
Testbed: eu-west-1, A100-class nodes, steady 70% util
Redwood: p50 36ms, p95 100ms, cost-per-convo $0.016
CloudManaged: p50 84ms, p95 220ms, cost-per-convo $0.042
Self-host baseline: p50 30ms, p95 310ms (spiky), cost-per-convo $0.028
```

tara_marketing: Perfect. Public phrasing should be relative: "~2x lower p95 vs CloudManaged in our tests" and label slide internal until legal OKs. Add a one-liner test conditions on slide.

zoe_sales: I'll own SDR one-pager + procurement scripts. Hooks: 1) "Tail latency keeping you up?" 2) "Want predictable unit costs?" 3) "Need enterprise controls without heavy ops?" Rebuttals: "we run infra" -> "reduce ops with our control plane + Dedicated pools"; "data sensitivity" -> "Private/VPC + KMS/HSM + audit logs"; "pricing" -> "show volume, we'll model reserved vs on-demand."

amo_content: Draft hero for landing: "Predictable LLM inference 6mdash; lower tail latency, transparent unit economics, automatic fallbacks." Short social variant: "Serve LLMs predictably 6mdash; lower p95, clearer economics."

ops_bot: bench artifacts uploaded to internal storage (link withheld)

tara_marketing: Routing rules for webinar leads: form fields: company size, intended usage, compliance needs, SLA interest. Triggers: SLA interest OR company size>500 OR usage==prod -> enterprise; compliance or private interest -> solutions eng; else -> trial SDR nurture. Add a poll (latency/cost/compliance) to help route.

liam_research: I'll sanitize the slide table (p50/p95/cost) and a small p95 bar chart by tomorrow morning.

zoe_sales: I'll prepare a 1M conv/month ROI example using Liam's numbers and short SDR talking points by 5pm today.

tara_marketing: Great. Owners: Zoe (SDR doc + ROI), Liam (bench slide + chart), Amo (copy + heroes), Tara (assemble + run dry-run Tue 9:50am PT). Keep claims defensible and mark internal where needed.

(END)
